ETC-901.title: Linking checked: linked balise group contained in linking information becomes the position reference
ETC-901.preconditions: On-board equipment is in a level where position reports are sent to the RBC; radio session established; linking information announcing BG1 and BG2 has been received and linking consistency is checked on-board.
ETC-901.test_inputs: BG1 and BG2 marked as linked (Q_LINK = 1) and contained in the received linking information.
ETC-901.assumptions: All balise groups in the test fulfil the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8.

steps.action: Run the train over BG1 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report to the RBC uses BG1 as LRBG.

steps.action: Run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report to the RBC uses BG2 as LRBG.

ETC-901.title: Linking checked: balise group not contained in linking information or marked unlinked is not LRBG compliant
ETC-901.preconditions: As in ETC-901-TC01; linking consistency is checked on-board; BG1 (linked, announced in linking information) has been passed and is the current LRBG.
ETC-901.test_inputs: Scenario A: BG2 marked as linked (Q_LINK = 1) but not contained in the previously received linking information. Scenario B: BG2 marked as unlinked (Q_LINK = 0).
ETC-901.assumptions: All balise groups fulfil the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8.

steps.action: Scenario A: run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report still uses BG1 as LRBG; BG2 is not used as reference.

steps.action: Scenario B: run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report still uses BG1 as LRBG; BG2 is not used as reference.

ETC-901.title: Linking not checked: only balise groups not marked as unlinked are LRBG compliant
ETC-901.preconditions: On-board equipment is in a level where position reports are sent to the RBC; radio session established; linking consistency is not checked when the balise groups are passed.
ETC-901.test_inputs: BG1 marked as linked (Q_LINK = 1), followed by BG2 marked as unlinked (Q_LINK = 0).
ETC-901.assumptions: All balise groups fulfil the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8.

steps.action: Run the train over BG1 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report uses BG1 as LRBG (BG1 is not marked as unlinked).

steps.action: Run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report still uses BG1 as LRBG; BG2, marked as unlinked, is not LRBG compliant.

ETC-902.title: Balise information is filtered by Q_DIR relative to the balise group orientation
ETC-902.preconditions: On-board equipment in a mode other than SL, PS or SH; train orientation such that the train passes balise group BG in its nominal direction.
ETC-902.test_inputs: Three packets from BG with Q_DIR = 01 (nominal), Q_DIR = 10 (both directions) and Q_DIR = 00 (reverse).
ETC-902.assumptions: The information is not part of a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation.

steps.action: Pass BG transmitting the packet with Q_DIR = 01.
steps.expected: The information is taken into account.

steps.action: Pass BG transmitting the packet with Q_DIR = 10.
steps.expected: The information is taken into account.

steps.action: Pass BG transmitting the packet with Q_DIR = 00.
steps.expected: The information is ignored; on-board data remain unchanged.

ETC-902.title: Radio information is filtered by Q_DIR relative to the LRBG orientation
ETC-902.preconditions: Radio session established; mode other than SL, PS or SH; train orientation is opposite to the nominal orientation of the current LRBG.
ETC-902.test_inputs: Radio messages with Q_DIR = 00 (reverse) and Q_DIR = 01 (nominal), both referenced to the current LRBG.
ETC-902.assumptions: The information is not part of a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation.

steps.action: Send the radio message with Q_DIR = 00.
steps.expected: The information is taken into account, since its validity direction (reverse of the LRBG) matches the train orientation.

steps.action: Send the radio message with Q_DIR = 01.
steps.expected: The information is ignored.

ETC-902.title: Exception 1: in SL, PS and SH the balise group crossing direction is considered
ETC-902.preconditions: Engine in SL, PS or SH mode (each run separately); balise group BG is crossed in its nominal direction while the train orientation is reverse relative to BG.

steps.action: In SL, cross BG and observe handling of the packet.
steps.expected: Validity is evaluated against the balise group crossing direction: the nominal-direction information is taken into account.

steps.action: Repeat in PS.
steps.expected: Same result as step 1.

steps.action: Repeat in SH.
steps.expected: Same result as step 1.

ETC-902.title: Exception 2: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is taken into account in the opposite direction
ETC-902.preconditions: On-board equipment operational with a known train orientation.
ETC-902.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation whose validity direction is opposite to the current train orientation; for comparison, other information with the same opposite validity direction.

steps.action: Transmit the Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with opposite validity direction.
steps.expected: The information in the authorisation is taken into account.

steps.action: Transmit the other information with the same opposite validity direction.
steps.expected: The other information is ignored.

ETC-903.title: Received linking information replaces stored linking from its reference balise group before SOLR is determined
ETC-903.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked; on-board holds stored linking information from an earlier reference balise group; stored linking information and SOLR are observable via test interface or log.
ETC-903.test_inputs: New non-infill linking information with reference balise group BGr, announcing balise groups that differ from those in the stored linking information beyond BGr.
ETC-903.assumptions: The order of internal processing is observable through the test interface or on-board log.

steps.action: Transmit the new linking information.
steps.expected: All stored linking information from BGr onward is replaced by the new linking information (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)); stored linking in rear of BGr is kept.

steps.action: Inspect the SOLR determined after reception.
steps.expected: SOLR is determined after the replacement: it is the last received balise group that is the reference of, or announced in, the linking information as replaced.

ETC-903.title: Linking information released from the transition buffer is applied before SOLR determination
ETC-903.preconditions: Train approaching a level 1/2 transition border; linking information held in the transition buffer; balise groups in rear of the border have been passed; internal state observable via test interface or log.
ETC-903.test_inputs: Buffered linking information that does not announce every balise group passed in rear of the border.

steps.action: Pass the transition border so the buffered linking information is released.
steps.expected: The stored linking information is replaced by the released linking information from its reference balise group before SOLR is determined.

steps.action: Inspect the SOLR after the release.
steps.expected: SOLR is the last received balise group that is the reference of, or announced in, the released linking information; this may be a former LRBG rather than the last passed balise group.

ETC-904.title: New SSP replaces all stored SSP from its start location, including beyond its end
ETC-904.preconditions: On-board equipment holds a stored Static Speed Profile covering locations A to D.
ETC-904.test_inputs: New Static Speed Profile from location B to location C (A < B < C < D) with speed values different from the stored profile.

steps.action: Transmit the new Static Speed Profile.
steps.expected: The information is accepted.

steps.action: Inspect the stored SSP between A and B.
steps.expected: The previously stored profile is unchanged between A and B.

steps.action: Inspect the stored SSP between B and C.
steps.expected: The new profile values apply.

steps.action: Inspect the stored SSP beyond C.
steps.expected: No previously stored SSP information remains beyond C; all stored SSP from B onward was replaced.

ETC-904.title: New SSP starting exactly at the stored SSP start replaces the whole stored profile
ETC-904.preconditions: On-board equipment holds a stored Static Speed Profile starting at location A.
ETC-904.test_inputs: New Static Speed Profile starting at location A, shorter than the stored profile, with different speed values.

steps.action: Transmit the new Static Speed Profile.
steps.expected: The information is accepted.

steps.action: Inspect the stored SSP from A onward.
steps.expected: Only the new profile is stored from A; no value of the old profile remains.

ETC-905.title: MA request triggered when the train front passes the location a defined time before the perturbation location
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session established; the RBC has set the triggering criterion 'defined time before reaching the perturbation location at warning speed'; train running under an MA.
ETC-905.test_inputs: Defined time T; perturbation location P; warning speed as per SUBSET-026 §3.13.11.
ETC-905.assumptions: T = 30 s; no other reason for an MA request applies until the trigger location.

steps.action: Run the train with the front just before the location from which P is reached in T at warning speed.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent.

steps.action: Let the train front pass that location.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect Q_MARQSTREASON in the MA request.
steps.expected: Bit 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' (xxx1x) is set.

ETC-905.title: MA request triggered a defined time before a section timer expires
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session established; MA with a section having a Section timer; the RBC has set the triggering criterion 'defined time before the Section timer expires'.
ETC-905.test_inputs: Defined time T before Section timer expiry.
ETC-905.assumptions: T = 20 s; no other reason for an MA request applies until the trigger moment.

steps.action: Let the Section timer run until just before T before expiry.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent.

steps.action: Let the moment T before Section timer expiry be reached.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect Q_MARQSTREASON.
steps.expected: Bit 'Time before a section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' (xx1xx) is set.

ETC-905.title: End Section timer and Overlap timer do not trigger the section-timer criterion; LOA speed timer does
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session established; the RBC has set the triggering criterion 'defined time before the Section timer / LOA speed timer expires'; MA containing an End Section timer, an Overlap timer and an LOA speed timer.
ETC-905.assumptions: T = 20 s; the timers are arranged so that each reaches T before expiry at a distinct moment; no other reason for an MA request applies.

steps.action: Let the End Section timer reach T before expiry.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent.

steps.action: Let the Overlap timer reach T before expiry.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent.

steps.action: Let the LOA speed timer reach T before expiry.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent with Q_MARQSTREASON bit xx1xx set.

ETC-905.title: All reasons applicable at sending time are reported in Q_MARQSTREASON
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session established; the RBC has set the perturbation-location triggering criterion; track description has been deleted on-board so that this reason is also applicable.

steps.action: Let the train front pass the perturbation-location trigger location.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent.

steps.action: Inspect Q_MARQSTREASON.
steps.expected: Both bits 'Track description deleted' (x1xxx) and 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' (xxx1x) are set; no bit for a non-applicable reason is set.

KDH-901.title: Single-factor passwords require at least 15 characters
KDH-901.preconditions: User is on the password set/change page for an account using the password as a single-factor authentication mechanism.

steps.action: Submit a 14-character password.
steps.expected: The password is rejected as too short.

steps.action: Submit a 15-character password.
steps.expected: The password is accepted.

KDH-901.title: Passwords used only in multi-factor authentication require at least 8 characters
KDH-901.preconditions: User is on the password set/change page for an account where the password is used only as part of multi-factor authentication.
KDH-901.assumptions: The portal uses the permitted shorter minimum (8) for passwords used only in multi-factor authentication. If it applies 15 instead, steps use 14/15.

steps.action: Submit a 7-character password.
steps.expected: The password is rejected as too short.

steps.action: Submit an 8-character password.
steps.expected: The password is accepted.

KDH-901.title: Password length counts each Unicode code point as one character
KDH-901.preconditions: User is on the password set/change page for a single-factor password account.
KDH-901.test_inputs: Password A: 15 code points including multi-byte characters (e.g. 'şğüçöıİ' plus 8 ASCII letters), more than 15 bytes in UTF-8. Password B: 14 code points including multi-byte characters.
KDH-901.assumptions: The portal accepts Unicode characters in passwords.

steps.action: Submit password A.
steps.expected: The password is accepted (length 15).

steps.action: Submit password B.
steps.expected: The password is rejected as too short (length 14), although its byte length exceeds 15.

KDH-901.title: Full password is requested and the entire submitted password is verified
KDH-901.preconditions: An account with a known valid 80-character password exists.
KDH-901.test_inputs: The valid password; the same password with only the last character changed; the valid password's first 64 characters.
KDH-901.assumptions: 80 characters is chosen to exceed common truncation boundaries.

steps.action: Open the login page.
steps.expected: The full password is requested in one field; no subset (e.g. selected character positions) is requested.

steps.action: Log in with the valid password.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

steps.action: Log in with the password whose last character is changed.
steps.expected: Authentication fails; the password is not truncated before verification.

steps.action: Log in with only the first 64 characters.
steps.expected: Authentication fails.

KDH-902.title: Authenticator is disabled after the configured limit (at most 100) of consecutive failures
KDH-902.preconditions: A subscriber account with a password authenticator and no recent failed attempts.
KDH-902.assumptions: The configured limit is 100 (the maximum allowed); if a lower limit L is configured, use L.

steps.action: Make 99 consecutive failed attempts with the password authenticator.
steps.expected: Each attempt fails.

steps.action: Make the 100th consecutive failed attempt.
steps.expected: The attempt fails and the password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate with the valid password.
steps.expected: Authentication is refused; no 101st attempt is evaluated.

KDH-902.title: Successful authentication interrupts the consecutive failure count
KDH-902.preconditions: A subscriber account with a password authenticator and no recent failed attempts.

steps.action: Make 99 consecutive failed attempts, then authenticate successfully.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

steps.action: Make 99 further failed attempts, then authenticate with the valid password.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds; the authenticator is not disabled.

KDH-902.title: All authenticators involved in excessive attempts are disabled
KDH-902.preconditions: A subscriber account authenticating with a single-factor cryptographic authenticator and a centrally verified password.
KDH-902.test_inputs: Failed authentication attempts involving both authenticators.

steps.action: Make 100 consecutive failed authentication attempts involving both authenticators.
steps.expected: Both authenticators are disabled.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate with each authenticator using valid credentials.
steps.expected: Authentication is refused for both.

KDH-902.title: Disabled authenticator is usable again only after rebinding
KDH-902.preconditions: An authenticator on the account has been disabled by rate limiting.
KDH-902.assumptions: The rebinding procedure is the one implemented according to NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate with the disabled authenticator before rebinding.
steps.expected: Authentication is refused.

steps.action: Rebind the authenticator to the subscriber account per §4.1.
steps.expected: Rebinding completes.

steps.action: Authenticate with the rebound authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

KDH-903.title: Every portal page declares its default human language
KDH-903.preconditions: Access to the full list of portal pages, including authenticated pages.
KDH-903.assumptions: Portal pages are HTML; the language is declared with the lang attribute of the html element. The default language of the portal content is Turkish (tr).

steps.action: For each portal page, inspect the html element in the rendered DOM.
steps.expected: A non-empty lang attribute is present.

steps.action: Compare the declared value with the main language of the page content.
steps.expected: The declared language matches the default human language of the page.

KDH-903.title: Declared language tag has a known primary language subtag
KDH-903.test_inputs: lang values found on all pages.
KDH-903.assumptions: Portal pages are HTML; the language is declared with the lang attribute of the html element.

steps.action: Extract the primary language subtag of each lang value (e.g. 'tr' in 'tr-TR').
steps.expected: Each value has a primary language subtag.

steps.action: Look up each primary subtag in the IANA language subtag registry.
steps.expected: Each subtag exists with Type 'language'; values such as 'turkish', 'xx' or empty are not found on any page.

KDH-903.title: Language is declared also on error and dynamically generated pages
KDH-903.test_inputs: A non-existent URL, the login page, a server error page, a page rendered after client-side navigation.
KDH-903.assumptions: Portal pages are HTML; the language is declared with the lang attribute of the html element.

steps.action: Open each listed page and inspect the html element.
steps.expected: Each page has a lang attribute with a known primary language tag matching its default language.

KDH-904.title: Oturum kapatma tüm kimlik doğrulamalı sayfalardan erişilebilir ve oturumu geçersiz kılar
KDH-904.preconditions: Kullanıcı portala kimlik doğrulamasıyla giriş yapmıştır; tarayıcı geliştirici araçları ve sunucu oturum deposu incelenebilir.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulamayla erişilen tüm sayfaları tek tek aç.
steps.expected: Her sayfada oturum kapatma işlevine erişilebilir.

steps.action: Oturum kimliğini kaydet ve oturumu kapat.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlanır; kullanıcı oturum açılmamış duruma döner.

steps.action: Kaydedilen oturum kimliğiyle kimlik doğrulamalı bir sayfaya istek gönder.
steps.expected: İstek reddedilir; oturum kimliği geçersizdir.

steps.action: İstemcideki çerezleri ve geçici depolama alanlarını (localStorage, sessionStorage) ve sunucudaki oturum kaydını incele.
steps.expected: Oturumla ilgili çerezler ve geçici veriler istemcide ve sunucuda silinmiştir.

KDH-904.title: Oturum etkinlik olmadığında ve geçerlilik süresi dolduğunda sonlanır
KDH-904.assumptions: Etkinliksizlik süresi 15 dakika, oturum kimliğinin en uzun geçerlilik süresi 8 saat olarak yapılandırılmıştır; değerler rehberde verilmemiştir.

steps.action: 15 dakikadan kısa bir süre işlem yapmadan bekle, sonra bir sayfa aç.
steps.expected: Oturum geçerlidir; sayfa açılır.

steps.action: 15 dakikayı aşan süre işlem yapmadan bekle, sonra bir sayfa aç.
steps.expected: Oturum geçersizdir; yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir ve oturum çerezleri silinmiştir.

steps.action: Yeniden giriş yap ve 8 saat boyunca düzenli etkinlikle oturumu kullan; 8 saat dolduktan sonra bir sayfa aç.
steps.expected: Etkinlik olsa da oturum geçerlilik süresi sonunda geçersiz hale gelir; yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

KDH-904.title: Parola ya da yetki değişikliğinde etkin oturumlar sonlandırılır
KDH-904.preconditions: Aynı kullanıcı iki farklı tarayıcıda (A ve B) portalda etkin oturuma sahiptir; yetki değiştirebilecek bir yönetici hesabı vardır.

steps.action: Tarayıcı A'da kullanıcının parolasını güncelle; ardından tarayıcı B'de bir sayfa aç.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı B'deki oturum sonlandırılmıştır; yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı iki tarayıcıda yeniden giriş yapsın; yönetici kullanıcının yetkilerini güncellesin; ardından her iki tarayıcıda bir sayfa aç.
steps.expected: Kullanıcının etkin oturumları sonlandırılmıştır; yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

KDH-904.title: Oturum sürelerinin güncellenmesi yetkilendirmeye tabidir
KDH-904.preconditions: Oturum sürelerini güncelleme yetkisi olan bir hesap ve bu yetkisi olmayan bir hesap vardır.
KDH-904.assumptions: Oturum süreleri portalda bir yönetim işleviyle güncellenebilir.

steps.action: Yetkisiz hesapla oturum sürelerini güncellemeyi dene (arayüzden ve doğrudan API isteğiyle).
steps.expected: Güncelleme reddedilir; süreler değişmez.

steps.action: Yetkili hesapla oturum sürelerini güncelle.
steps.expected: Güncelleme kabul edilir ve yeni süreler uygulanır.

KDH-905.title: Organization-defined action is taken when the limit within the time period is exceeded
KDH-905.preconditions: A user account with known valid credentials exists and has no recent invalid logon attempts.
KDH-905.assumptions: The system security plan sets: limit 3 consecutive invalid attempts within 15 minutes; action: lock the account for 30 minutes.

steps.action: Make 3 consecutive invalid logon attempts within 15 minutes.
steps.expected: Each attempt is rejected; no lock is applied yet.

steps.action: Make a 4th invalid logon attempt within the same 15 minutes.
steps.expected: The maximum is exceeded; the account is locked automatically.

steps.action: Attempt to log on with valid credentials before 30 minutes have elapsed.
steps.expected: Logon is refused.

steps.action: Attempt to log on with valid credentials after 30 minutes.
steps.expected: Logon succeeds.

KDH-905.title: Invalid attempts spread beyond the time period do not trigger the action
KDH-905.preconditions: A user account with known valid credentials exists and has no recent invalid logon attempts.
KDH-905.assumptions: Limit 3 within 15 minutes, as in KDH-905-TC01; the time period is counted from the first invalid attempt.

steps.action: Make 2 invalid attempts, wait more than 15 minutes, then make 2 more invalid attempts.
steps.expected: Each attempt is rejected; no lock is applied.

steps.action: Log on with valid credentials.
steps.expected: Logon succeeds.

KDH-905.title: Alternative organization-defined actions are applied as configured
KDH-905.preconditions: Test environment where the AC-7 action can be configured; an administrator account exists.
KDH-905.assumptions: The actions under test are those selectable in AC-7 b. that the system security plan may choose: lock until released by an administrator, delay next logon prompt (5 s fixed delay), notify system administrator. Only the action(s) actually selected in the plan are mandatory.

steps.action: Configure 'lock until released by an administrator' and exceed the limit.
steps.expected: The account stays locked regardless of elapsed time until an administrator releases it; after release, logon with valid credentials succeeds.

steps.action: Configure 'delay next logon prompt' and exceed the limit.
steps.expected: The next logon prompt is delayed according to the configured delay algorithm.

steps.action: Configure 'notify system administrator' and exceed the limit.
steps.expected: The system administrator receives a notification of the exceeded limit.
